name: Stats: Showcase
summary: A heading over a two-by-two grid of stat cards, each with an icon chip, a large tabular number, a label, and a bar whose width is the number as a share of its maximum.
useWhen: Summarising a few headline numbers on a marketing or about page, with a bar under each one
Showing progress against a target, where each stat has a known maximum
avoidWhen: The numbers need a trend or history; use a chart or a KPI card with a change figure
There are more than about six stats; use a metrics table instead
